description: Programs that help pay for a home EV charger in a U.S. state or the District of Columbia: the state's own programs and those of its largest electric utilities that have been checked so far, each with the program, who runs it, the amount, who qualifies, its status (open, waitlist or closed), its end date when stated, and where to apply, read from an official page on the day given. A state or utility with no program names the page that was checked; a utility that funds a statewide program names it. Tax credits are not included. Give a state's name or two-letter code, or omit it for every state.

state.description: A state's name or two-letter postal code, for example Maryland or MD. Omit for every state.

name: charger_rebates
title: Find a state's home EV charger rebates
